entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for my VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, order number is VF886-015.

Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see your order, delivered on December 15th. Before we proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault. The pulse sensor is completely unreliable. I've compared it to other devices, and the readings from this VeloBand are just garbage.

I'm sorry to hear that it's not working as expected. Our standard process for a reported defect is to connect you with our technical support team to troubleshoot the device. They can often resolve these issues quickly.
I appreciate the offer, but I really **don't have time** to go through a whole tech support call. The product doesn't work. I **just want my money** back. Can we please just process the **refund**?
So you'd prefer to skip any troubleshooting and go straight to the return, is that correct?
Yes, precisely. If it's this faulty out of the box, I'm not interested in a replacement. Let's just settle this with a return.
Understood. Let me just check the return eligibility based on your delivery date. Please hold one moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience, Sam. I've just consulted our return policy, and it looks like all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. So since it's only been 23 days, we're good to go?

That's right. You are well within the timeframe. I've gone ahead and approved the return for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Perfect. That was much easier than I expected. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
